title: Neurofeedback as a Treatment Tool for Depression
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to investigate whether neurofeedback delivered via functional magnetic resonance imaging signals can be used to train depressed patients to self-regulate emotion networks and whether this improves clinical symptoms.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* major depressive disorder (MDD) diagnosis
* stable antidepressant dose medication

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other physical or psychiatric disorders
* Current substance abuse
* Current psychotherapy or other specific intervention
* Exclusion criteria applicable to MRI
